name: PowerToys
title: PowerToys: free DisplayFusion alternative
caption:
DisplayFusion Pro costs $34 to add power-user tools to Windows. Microsoft's PowerToys gives you 30+ for free 🧰

✅ Text Extractor copies text from anywhere on your screen, even inside images
✅ Color Picker grabs any colour on screen and copies it
✅ Image Resizer and PowerRename handle files in bulk
✅ Peek, File Locksmith, Always On Top and more

💻 Windows 10 · 11
ℹ️ Made by Microsoft and Windows only. DisplayFusion Pro is a $34 one-time licence focused on multi-monitor setups, so the two only partly overlap

dm_pitch: PowerToys, Microsoft's free open-source toolkit for Windows 🧰

beats.say: If you use Windows, stop scrolling. You're missing thirty free utilities.
DisplayFusion charges thirty four bucks. PowerToys costs nothing.
Point at any color on your screen, and it copies the code.
One shortcut opens a search bar for your apps, files and commands.
It also pulls text out of images, renames files in bulk, and resizes photos.
It's a Swiss Army knife for Windows, minus the price tag.
